Recent related events (events are separated by numbered tags): <1> On September 28, 2023, Epic Games, the developer of the popular game Fortnite, announced it was laying off approximately 16% of its staff, which amounted to about 830 employees. [2, 5] The company's CEO, Tim Sweeney, stated in a memo to employees that the decision was a result of the company spending significantly more money than it was earning. [1, 5] He explained that while Fortnite's growth was being driven by creator content with substantial revenue sharing, this represented a lower margin business compared to the initial success of Fortnite Battle Royale. [1] In addition to the layoffs, Epic Games also divested from the music platform Bandcamp, which was sold to Songtradr, and spun off most of its kid-safe technology company, SuperAwesome. [1, 3] These divestitures resulted in about 250 people leaving the company. [3] The layoffs were part of a broader trend of job cuts within the video game industry. [2, 4] <2> North American esports organization TSM officially sold its franchise slot in the League of Legends Championship Series (LCS) to Shopify Rebellion, a Canadian esports organization. This event concluded TSM's decade-long, foundational presence in the top tier of North American League of Legends, during which they won seven LCS titles. The sale, reportedly for US$10 million, was announced on September 20, 2023. TSM had previously announced its intention to leave the LCS in May 2023, with plans to join a different competitive region. As part of the acquisition, Shopify Rebellion absorbed TSM's existing League of Legends roster . <3> The Halo Championship Series (HCS) held its Fort Worth Major tournament from September 1 to September 3, 2023, at the Fort Worth Convention Center in Texas. The event featured a total of 60 teams competing for a $250,000 prize pool. The top eight teams from the tournament secured a spot in the Halo World Championship 2023. The winners of the Fort Worth Major were OpTic Gaming, who defeated Spacestation Gaming in the grand final. The eight qualifying teams for the Halo World Championship were OpTic Gaming, Spacestation Gaming, Native Gaming Red, FaZe Clan, Shopify Rebellion, Quadrant, Sentinels, and Gamers First. <4> The Apex Legends Global Series (ALGS) Year 3 Championship, a major offline tournament organized by EA and Respawn Entertainment, concluded the 2023 competitive season. [1] The event took place in Birmingham, UK, at the Resorts World Arena from September 6th to September 10th, 2023. [2, 4, 7] Forty of the world's top Apex Legends teams competed for a $2,000,000 prize pool. [2, 4] The tournament was structured in three stages: a Group Stage (September 6-7), a double-elimination Bracket Stage (September 8-9), and the Match Point Finals (September 10). [1, 3] Ultimately, TSM was crowned the champion, earning the $600,000 grand prize. [4] <5> Am 14. August 2023 gab die E-Sport-Organisation FaZe Clan ihre Finanzergebnisse für das zweite Quartal, das am 30. Juni 2023 endete, bekannt. [5] Das Unternehmen meldete einen Nettoverlust von 14,35 Millionen US-Dollar und einen Umsatzrückgang auf 11,7 Millionen US-Dollar von 18,8 Millionen US-Dollar im Vorjahresquartal. [2, 3] FaZe Clan führte den Umsatzrückgang hauptsächlich auf eine Verlangsamung der Sponsoring-Einnahmen von Marken zurück, die durch das allgemeine makroökonomische Klima und die erhöhte Geschäftsunsicherheit für Partner beeinflusst wurden. [2, 3] Diese Nachricht kam auch inmitten von Berichten über erhebliche Personalentlassungen, bei denen im Laufe des Jahres 2023 etwa 40 % der Belegschaft in zwei Runden abgebaut wurden, um die Kosten zu senken. [1, 9, 10] <6> On July 18, 2023, Riot Games, the developer of 'League of Legends' and 'Valorant', announced a three-year partnership with esports company GGTech Entertainment to manage its North American collegiate esports operations. Under the agreement, GGTech became the official operator for the College League of Legends (CLoL) and College VALORANT (CVAL) competitive seasons, starting with the 2023-24 school year. The collaboration aims to create a centralized 'one-stop-shop' for Riot's collegiate programs, which also includes the college club program and other events. The Riot Scholastic Association of America (RSAA) will continue to be closely involved in the strategy and direction of the collegiate ecosystem. This partnership builds on GGTech's existing relationship with Riot, for whom it already operates collegiate esports in the EMEA and Latin American regions. <7> The 2023 Overwatch League Grand Finals, the sixth and final championship of the league, concluded on October 1, 2023, at the Mattamy Athletic Centre in Toronto, Canada. [2, 3] The Florida Mayhem were crowned the champions, defeating the Houston Outlaws with a decisive 4-0 victory to secure their first-ever league title. [2, 5] The announcement that the playoffs and Grand Finals would be held in Toronto was made on July 15, 2023. [4, 9] The playoff tournament began on September 28, 2023, leading up to the final match. [3, 4] <8> The Apex Legends Global Series (ALGS) Year 3 Split 2 Playoffs, organized by Respawn Entertainment and EA, took place from July 13 to July 16, 2023, at the Copper Box Arena in London. The event featured 40 of the world's top Apex Legends teams from regions including North America, EMEA, and APAC, competing for a $1 million prize pool. The tournament followed a multi-stage format, including a Group Stage, a double-elimination Bracket Stage, and a Match Point Finals. For the first time in ALGS history, every match was played on the main stage. Ultimately, DarkZero Esports emerged as the champion, winning the grand prize of $300,000. TSM and Oxygen Esports secured second and third place, respectively. <9> The Valorant Champions 2023, the third annual championship and culminating event of the 2023 Valorant Champions Tour (VCT), took place from August 6 to August 26, 2023. Riot Games officially announced Los Angeles as the host city on March 4, 2023. The tournament featured sixteen of the world's best teams competing for the title of World Champion and a share of a $2,250,000 prize pool. The competition was held across two venues in California: the group stage and early playoffs at the Shrine Auditorium and Expo Hall, and the final matches at the Kia Forum in Inglewood. In the grand final, the North American team Evil Geniuses defeated Paper Rex with a score of 3-1 to win the championship.
